Title: Relates to prohibiting the consideration of credit history in the underwriting, cancellation, renewal or calculation of cost of homeowners' insurance
Summary: Relates to prohibiting insurers from refusing to underwrite, cancel or refuse to renew a policy for homeowners' insurance based on the credit history of an applicant or an insured.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to prohibiting insurers from making decisions about the underwriting, cancellation, renewal or calculation of cost of homeowners' insurance based on the credit history of an applicant or an insured
